before.reason: Actual alien gifts begin sectoral displacement, while a generalized post-work settlement remains prospective.
before.analysis: Fuel-free cars are really budded and tested (ordinary-fetch lines 7050-7057), and houses appear later. Yet much of the distribution account is explicitly conditional: enough cars for every American, later appliances, and food only if a future shortage develops (7073-7107, 7304-7310). Ordinary workers still have mortgage obligations and operating assembly lines; some residents cannot reach the gift stock behind a cordon (7806-7820, 8160-8176). The final international-policy discussion calls for a new economic structure rather than depicting its completed institutions (8474-8504). The possible figures inside a new house are a witness's uncertain inference, not verified manufactured humans.
before.follow_up: Preserve as a transition and technological-displacement comparison. Reopen for a specifically supported population or implemented major provision system; do not turn conditional food aid into an existing guarantee, biological visitors into sovereign AI, or a rumored gift ban into an enacted zero variant.

after.reason: Retain the actual material-gift transition without promoting forecasts into completed welfare.

before.reason: The Engineers are an active robot civilization on a cosmological mission, not a demonstrated post-work economy for its human visitors.
before.analysis: Their explicit late account identifies them as robots made by an extinct people and subsequently reproducing and improving themselves (ordinary-fetch lines 4600-4646). Their maintenance and long lives do not make them inactive, and the plot requires human imaginative work the Engineers lack (2446-2508). No resident human population with ordinary allocation rules was established. The separate collective mind which rejected machine civilization is another society, not evidence about the Engineers (3952-3996); biological collective consciousness is not automatically AI sovereignty.
before.follow_up: Keep as a working machine-civilization comparison. Reopen only with a defensible resident-person proxy and internal material/labor evidence. Do not derive 100% leisure from absent humans or transfer the collective mind's capabilities to the Engineers.

after.reason: Retain the famous active robot civilization with real work and separate populations visible.

before.reason: The current Tralfamadorian population consists of machines; its creators' fate is an internal origin legend.
before.analysis: The late Titan chapter explicitly identifies Salo and his fellows as machines which manufacture each other (web lines 1501-1510). The organic population's delegation of ever-higher purposes ends in extermination in the legend. The machine civilization has no established resident human denominator, and the legend supplies no dependable access or control constitution for a living biological society. Salo also undertakes an assigned mission and makes art; machine identity is not automatic idleness.
before.follow_up: Preserve as an autonomous-machine and purpose comparison. Reopen the pre-extinction legendary period only as a separately labeled proxy if its production/access structure can be substantiated; never score extermination as human leisure or import Slaughterhouse-Five's aliens.

after.reason: Retain the famous machine civilization without turning its internal legend into a factual human-leisure story.

before.reason: Automatic commercial fiction is verified; society-wide material provision or a deliberate zero-variant employment order is not.
before.analysis: The reference and indexed primary opening establish wordmills, human tending/persona roles and robot authors working for robot readers. That is a real literary-automation lead, but maintaining equipment is still useful work and a marketing role alone does not establish an economy-wide work-preservation policy. Broad secondary claims that robots do everything need primary confirmation of ordinary access to goods, ownership and household livelihood. Preserved living brains would also require their own active-person scope rather than automatic nonworker status.
before.follow_up: Read primary material on non-literary production, household income and the writers' union before deciding post-work versus zero variant. The consulted text mirror's 403 was respected; indexed fragments are not a completed novel read.

after.reason: Retain the direct automation/retained-role publishing institution with its narrow population explicit.

before.reason: The artificial world has immense productive capacity, but durable ordinary provisioning rights remain unverified.
before.analysis: Don's comfortable accommodation is guest or captive treatment, not an entitlement census. Chapter 36 distinguishes the wider civilization's democratic, security-focused elders from the Wanderer's dissidents and ambitions (ordinary-fetch lines 9550-9688). Constructed planets, immortality and malleable bodies are not proof of work-independent necessities or AI government. Tigerishka even presents thought-realizing devices as a problem still to solve. Human visitors are not silently substituted for all alien residents.
before.follow_up: Locate actual production and household-allocation passages for the Wanderer's population. If a point is retained, name an alien-person proxy and keep it distinct from the parent civilization; useful exploration, engineering and art still count as work.

after.reason: Retain the famous artificial-world community with local and wider institutions distinguished.

before.reason: Repeated robot displacement is direct, but the current evidence does not establish a qualifying general distribution system.
before.analysis: The opening shows Phil losing successive jobs to faster robots and living in subdivided housing; the Fun Incorporated scene shows robots selling commodities for money. Neither one displaced man nor automated retail establishes how most residents obtain necessities. No primary rule deliberately preserving replaceable employment was established either. The ending introduces mood-mediating alien symbionts and political acceptance, rather than a completed new material constitution; emotional peace is not automatic production.
before.follow_up: Check broader production ownership, unemployment support and access conditions before choosing a post-work or zero-variant classification. Keep the before-contact economy separate from the still-unfolding green-cat settlement.

after.reason: Retain the direct robot-displacement economy with useful informal activity included.
